title: fix(runtime): the bare action route serves the environment's own action on an object no holder of a refused name binds
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu6S7VJimLmKWg8xiuRfMvjH)_
Fixes #32751

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个包在别的对象上持有同名 action、而环境自己在第三个对象（如 `lead`）上写了同名的无包 action 时，裸路由 `/actions/lead/NAME` 现在直接读环境自有项（registry 里的无包项 + 环境存储里的无包行）并把它作为该路由的声明服务出来，不再答「无声明」。本 PR 只保证声明被服务；启动后的宿主上脚本体 action 是否被绑定并执行，由 #32990 单独处理；不经过任何持有者的精确地址，也不当作持有者的条目。
- 为什么改：#32568（PR #32741）关掉了「借第一个持有者的精确地址拿到无包副本」这条路，于是这类环境 action 今天在该路由上连声明都拿不到（本卡 p1，发版线）。
- 风险与回滚：只改执行面路由在「裸读被拒且没有候选持有者拥有这条路由」这一个分支的答案；有包（含已停用的包）绑定该对象、或该无包项在环境存储里没有行（宿主/插件代码）时仍答「无声明」；存储读失败答 503。不改存储与 schema，第一方计数为 0。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`（`environmentOwnerOfUnheldRoute`，以及 `routeOwnerOfRefusedRead` 末尾 `rung.length === 0` 一行）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/action-package-addressing.test.ts -t "#32751"`，预期 8 条全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Two packages hold an action of one name, A on `account` and B on `contact`, and the environment authors its own package-less action of that name on `lead`. The protocol's bare execution read refuses the name (two package holders), so the bare route recovers through `routeOwnerOfRefusedRead`, which reads each package candidate at its own exact address and keeps the one that owns the route. Before #32568 the first holder's address served the environment's package-less copy, so `lead` found the environment's declaration through A's address. #32568 closed that (a sealed type's package-less copy is declined at a holder's exact address, epic ruling 6817768147), and `lead` answered no declaration.

- `routeOwnerOfRefusedRead`: when no candidate owns the route and every candidate's own address answered, the route asks `environmentOwnerOfUnheldRoute` instead of answering no declaration. A candidate whose address could not be read still leaves the bare read's refusal standing, as before.
- `environmentOwnerOfUnheldRoute` (new, module-private): the registry's package-less item of the name that owns the route (bound to the routed object first, object-less after), served only when the environment's store holds its row bound to no package (`environmentStoredActionNames`, the same origin test the bare holder rule applies through `packagelessOriginOf`). It carries no package, so the dispatch is unqualified, as the bare call's always was. It never reads a holder's exact address (epic red line 2).
- It never answers when any package's action of the name owns the route, **a disabled package included**: an enabled one's own declaration answers there as before, and a disabled one keeps the route no declaration, which is main's answer there and stays so. The registry's listing with `includeDisabledPackages` is the read that sees one; the protocol's reads withhold it. It also answers no declaration for a package-less item with no row in the store (the platform's: host or plugin code), on an engine with no store (no `find`, or no `sys_metadata` object), and on a registry that cannot list every holder.
- A store read that fails for any other reason answers `degraded` (503), never no declaration (ADR-0110 D3).

The protocol's reads cannot answer this route: the execution face's bare read refuses the name, and the merged listing (`getMetaItems`) folds the package-less item into the holders' slots as their stand-in (ADR-0048), so the environment's item is not in it. No change to `packages/metadata-protocol` or `packages/objectql`.

### FROM → TO

| # | Route (A's `approve` on `account`, B's on `contact`, the environment's own on `lead` with its package-less row stored) | FROM (main `a7c97297`) | TO | Clause-② arm |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `/actions/lead/approve`, environment registered last | no declaration | the environment's action declaration, no package | widening |
| 2 | `/actions/lead/approve`, environment registered first | no declaration | the same | widening |
| 3 | `/actions/lead/approve`, the environment's item object-less, both orders | no declaration | the environment's action declaration, no package (an item bound to `lead` comes before an object-less one) | widening |

This PR serves the declaration. With the declaration served, the dispatch is unqualified and runs whatever handler the engine has bound for `lead` (the pin registers one and sees it run). A booted host does not yet bind a script-bodied environment action whose name a package also ships, so that body answers 404 at dispatch: measured on this head with a cold boot, and tracked in #32990, not here. Flow, update-record and API actions do not go through that binding.

Unchanged, pinned as CONTROLs: `/actions/account/approve` answers A's and `/actions/contact/approve` B's, in both orders. A disabled package's action bound to `lead` keeps `lead` no declaration, in both orders, as on main. The platform's item on `lead`, with no row behind it, stays no declaration. An engine with no metadata store keeps case 2's existing pin (no declaration, not `degraded`). An enabled third package bound to `lead` keeps `lead` on that package's own declaration, in both orders. A candidate whose own address answers `not-held-by-qualifier` keeps the bare read's refusal; neither ever yields the environment's item.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise re-measured on `main` `a7c97297` (after #32741 `a888c5c9e`) before any edit, with a probe that was then deleted. `lead` answered no declaration in both registration orders. The execution face's bare read refused naming A and B only, and each holder's exact address served that holder's own item.
- Measured, not in this PR, reported to the seat: the environment's own address `/actions/_env/lead/approve` (`resolveAddressedRouteActionDeclaration` with the environment qualifier) answers `404` in this state, and also beside ONE package holder. It reads the merged listing, which does not list the package-less item of a name a package holds. This PR does not route through it.
- Measured, not in this PR, reported to the seat: with A disabled and B enabled beside the environment's item, the execution face's bare read answers no item. So `/actions/contact/approve` (B's own route) and `/actions/lead/approve` both answer no declaration on `main`, and this PR leaves both unchanged. The read never refuses there, so the recovery this PR extends is not reached.
- First-party count: 0. No first-party composition has two packages holding one action name beside an environment action of that name.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`: a new `[#32751]` describe beside `case 2`, with eight cases. The environment's item on `lead` is served with no package and its handler runs, both orders. CONTROL: each holder's own route is unchanged, both orders. The environment's object-less item answers `lead`, both orders. A disabled package binding `lead` keeps it no declaration, both orders. The platform's item with no row stays no declaration. NEIGHBOUR: an enabled third package bound to `lead` answers its own declaration, both orders; a `not-held-by-qualifier` candidate keeps the refusal. A failing store read is `degraded`. `case 2`'s `lead` assertion now also asserts no `degraded`; its comment and the describe's header point at the new describe. The new describe's engine reads the same rows as the protocol's row store double, and like it refuses a `where` combinator it does not implement.
- Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed and restore verified by blob hash against `HEAD`; the runtime suite imports `./action-execution.js` from source, so no rebuild is involved):
  - the recovery answers no declaration in place of the environment read: 3 failed (the served pin, the object-less pin, the `degraded` pin);
  - the holder check removed: 1 failed (the disabled-holder pin);
  - the store origin test removed: 1 failed (the platform pin);
  - a failing store read answered as no declaration: 1 failed (the `degraded` pin);
  - an engine with no store answered as a failing read: 1 failed (`case 2`).
  - the environment read put before the unique owner, with the holder check removed: 1 failed (the enabled-third-package pin);
  - a candidate that could not be read no longer keeps the refusal: 1 failed (the `not-held-by-qualifier` pin).

## Verification

On head `fd531c37` (branch `claude/project-thread-svxbge`; `origin/main` merged by merge twice: `25ee5076` before the PR, `04c35f09` before the queue, 23 commits, no conflicts; the card's net diff over the new merge base is still the same 3 files):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`: 75 passed (75), on `fd531c37` after a full `packages/**` rebuild; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` (the whole suite, through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`) on the fix before the merge: Test Files 592 passed (592), Tests 11617 passed, 19 skipped. After the merge, with the closure rebuilt: every runtime test file matching `action`, Test Files 70 passed (70), Tests 1428 passed (1428).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`, the debt ledger held).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, every family recorded with its exit code (all 0). 51 families ran on `58d38923`. The 15 that read the test file (among them `check:where-matcher`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:type-check-debt`) ran again on `68ef9c71` after the store double was made to refuse a combinator it does not implement (`check:where-matcher` caught it on `58d38923`). `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first answered exit 3: the build was not complete and the clone was shallow. They ran again after a full packages build and `git fetch --unshallow`, and both exited 0. On `c9732c20` (test file and changeset only) the families that read them ran again: 24 families (the 13 test-file readers among them `check:where-matcher`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:type-check-debt`, and the 11 changeset and docs readers), all exit 0; `dispatch-gates --ran` 66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0. After the `04c35f09` merge, on `fd531c37` with the packages rebuilt, all 66 derived families ran again: 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, every exit 0.

</details>
